title: [Informações do servidor] Premium Service
bodyHtml:
original thread(ru) - *link*

Getting Premium: You can purchase premium in cash shop, for 2400 coins (30 days) or for 1200 coins (7 days). After using the premium capsule, you need to completely re-enter the game (quit the game and then login back).
There is also an additional option to purchase premium through the forum website (*link*).

Premium Bonuses:
  • Sword +1 movement speed
  • Auto-loot medal.
    The Auto-loot Medal does not work for turrets below level 50
Important! On our project, premium does not give bonuses to experience and Pt / skill / animuses. It also does not increase the PVP points limit.

Auto-loot medal information:

The auto-loot medal is a unique module that allows you not to waste precious time picking up loot from the floor.
  • If you are without a party, but with a medal, the loot drops immediately into the inventory.
  • If you are in a group, the loot is 'Shared' - all loot drops on the ground.
  • If you are in a group, the loot is 'On the leader' and the leader with a medal, the loot drops into the leader inventory.
    • If the loot is in the group 'On the leader', but he does not have a medal, the loot falls to the ground, but belongs to the leader.
  • If you are in a group, the loot is 'Queue' - the loot drops in queue, if a player without a medal is 1st in the queue, the loot drops on the ground, but belongs to that party member who was in queue. To all party members with a medal, loot drops into the inventory on their queue.
    • If the party member, whose turn it is to receive loot, is in a far distance, the loot drops on the ground.

  • The medal disappears as soon as the Premium Service period ends.
  • The medal does not work on any loot from Pit Bosses.
  • If you want to disable autoloot, just sell the medal to NPC. When you re-enter the game, the medal will automatically return to the inventory.



Premium service level:
If you have active premium, you will also receive premium points.

Spending cash shop on cash shop items - you receive premium points.
Buying cash shop capsules or premium service - doesn't count

After you reach certain amount of premium points - you will receive premium bonus level.


Premium level bonuses:
  • Level 1 - 30.000 shop spent = 1% EXP increase, 1% drop increase
  • Level 2 - 60.000 shop spent = 2% EXP increase , 2% drop increase
  • Level 3 - 100.000 shop spent = 3% EXP increase, 3% drop increase
  • Level 4 - 200.000 shop spent = 5% EXP increase, 5% drop increase
  • Level 5- - 400.000 shops spent = 8% EXP increase, 8% drop increase

Premium level bonuses are shared accross all character on the account.
